subject: How can I get a csv or table with group comparison results from MSStats?

messages.author: 08cf70d560b318d9
messages.subject: How can I get a csv or table with group comparison results from MSStats?
parts:
Hello,
 I'm looking for a way to get the related table result from MSStats for group comparison with log fold change value and adjusted p value (such as the one corresponding to volcano plot and heat map).
Is there anyone knows how to do it?
Thanks,
Thao

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: How can I get a csv or table with group comparison results from MSStats?
parts:
Hi,


currently, this requires a bit of manual work. Output of groupComparison function is list with "ComparisonResult" element. It's a data.frame with all the information. Using this object, you can save the relevant information with any function available in R such as write.table, fwrite etc.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
